title: Register New World as its own theme: id new-world, --nw-* tokens, theme contract entry, hidden

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: New World is the new mega template, default theme for every new Space

detail: Separate from Services (id `services`, untouched). Adds NEW_WORLD_TOKENS_CSS (three tiers: Frequency core verbatim, alias tier, scoped data-th night|day registers, OKLCH accents with vividness), themes.New World in theme-contract.json, the editor theme, the manifest at schema 2, and the SiteThemeId. Coordinate with the Services thread, which edits site-style.ts registration. Theme fence: tokens scoped to [data-house-theme="new-world"], stand-alone site render only.
